incident-bot: Pager: P1 - inference-service-eu error-rate spike detected (>10% 5xx) across multiple hosts. Pager sent to @Samir, @Maya. War room: https://warroom.redwood/5210001111 :rotating_light:
Samir (oncall): Acked. Joining war room now. Adding context: saw elevated tail latency ~1.2s and KV cache misses rising.
Maya (ops): On it. I'm taking incident owner. Creating status draft and customer comm.
Jordan (eng): I'll stand up a canary rollback and check the recent model deploys in eu-west. Pushing logs to war room.
Priya (SRE): Quick checks: autoscaler triggered a scale-up 3m ago, but some pods are in CrashLoopBackOff. Dumping pod list: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep eu-west`.
Samir (oncall): Confirmed crashloops on nodes eu-west-2. Suspect kernel OOM after nightly job. Initiating node drain plan if needed.
Liaison (support): Notifying impacted customers in EU segment with an interim message (we'll update every 30m). Holding final wording until Maya posts status snippet.
Maya (ops): Status page draft: `We are investigating increased error rates for text-generation in EU. Some requests are returning 5xx or experiencing increased latency. Root cause under investigation. We will provide updates in 30 minutes.` Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Jordan (eng): Suggest add "workaround in progress: rolling affected instances back to previous model revision" if we start rollback. Also track request-id sampling.
Samir (oncall): Proceed with rollback canary on 2 pods, monitor error rate, do not do full rollback yet. Priya, can you coordinate the node-drain if pods keep crashing?
Priya (SRE): Yes. I'll cordon the affected nodes and move remaining healthy pods. If crashes persist after rollback, I'll escalate to infra.
Maya (ops): Customer comm ready for support channel and status page. Liaison please send this to Tier 2 customers: `We are actively mitigating increased errors and will update within 30 minutes. No data loss expected.`
Liaison (support): Sending now to list. Will capture replies in war room.
Samir (oncall): Owner: @Maya. On-call lead: @Samir. War room: https://warroom.redwood/5210001111. Handoff checklist: 1) owner confirmed, 2) customer note sent, 3) rollback canary running, 4) node cordon in progress, 5) next update in 30m.
Maya (ops): Noted. I'll post an internal status update to #all-hands once we have rollback telemetry.
incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by Samir at 5210001115. Incident channel created: #inc-5210001111-oncall-bridge.
Samir (oncall): Logging runbook actions in the war room. If anyone sees a sudden increase in errors post-rollback, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Jordan (eng): Canary rolled back on 2/2 pods, error rate down from 12% -> 3% observed over 90s. Continuing to monitor.
Maya (ops): Good signal. Preparing status page update to reflect mitigation in progress.
Liaison (support): Customers on the EU tier notified of mitigation, some replies asking ETA. I'll route urgent ones to this thread.
Priya (SRE): Node cordon complete. No further CrashLoopBackOffs observed after rollback.
Samir (oncall): Last check: error rate stable at ~2.5%. Keeping this P1 active until we confirm full recovery and run postmortem. Next update in 30 minutes unless something changes.
